The '''MC40a light cruiser''' or '''Mon Calamari Light Cruiser''' was a [[Mon Calamari Star Cruiser/Legends|Mon Calamari Star Cruiser]] design.<ref name="TF" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:CRL-XWA.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Profile view of an MC40a light cruiser]]
The MC40 was a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] cruiser, larger than the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]].
It was equipped with powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] for a vessel of its size. Its three engines gave it a higher speed than the bigger [[MC80a Star Cruiser]], and it was more maneuverable.
The MC40 had a large, portside hangar and could carry one [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]].<ref name="TF" />

==History==
The MC40 [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] was constructed some time prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="TF" /> It saw heavy use in the year leading up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="XWA" />

Ships of this kind accompanied larger vessels like the [[MC80 Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]].<ref name="XWA" /> During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] the New Republic relocated most of its fleet to Kuat. These ships consisted of many Mon Calamari cruisers including MC40s and was established to strike the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
